name: blockchain
description: 1. docker compose up -d to start Ganache   2. Open Remix, paste SovereignTrash.sol, compile with Solidity 0.8.19+   3. In MetaMask: add network localhost:8545, Chain ID 1337, import accounts   from Ganache keys   4. In Remix: select "Injected Provider - MetaMask" → Deploy   5. Copy the deployed contract address and paste it into frontend/index.html   line where CONTRACT_ADDRESS is defined (the ABI is already embedded)   6. Open index.html in browser (or npx live-server frontend/)   7. Connect MetaMask and start dethroning!
